author: Megaprojects
description:
This episode examines whether nuclear power deserves its dangerous reputation by analysing deaths per terawatt hour across energy sources. Beginning with Chernobyl and tracing nuclear history, it explores anti-nuclear movements, radiation risks and mortality statistics from major incidents. Surprisingly, nuclear proves safer than coal, oil, gas and even hydroelectric power.
